outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram (breast anatomy illustration and a classification table), not a data plot showing averaged measurements.
Panel B is a conceptual/schematic diagram outlining the study aim, not a data plot.
Panel C is a schematic illustration of the experimental setup (reporter cell + luminometer icon), not a data plot with averages.

Panel D shows illustrative example traces (Model #1, #2, #3) representing types of circadian signal, not averaged/aggregated experimental data derived from replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel E is a schematic correlation heatmap illustrating the analysis concept; it is not an averaged summary statistic plot requiring display of underlying individual data points.
Panel F shows schematic example growth curves for three illustrative models, not an average computed across replicate experiments, so individual points are not required.
Panel G shows illustrative dose-response curves representing the concept of drug-sensitivity quantification, not real averaged replicate data needing individual points shown.
Panel H depicts schematic heatmap/mutation-matrix icons illustrating the type of genomic analysis performed, not an averaged data summary requiring individual points.
Panel I's PCA and 3D parameter scatter plots already display individual data points (dots) for each cell line, satisfying the requirement.
